edits.old: A $5 coffee on 250 working days is $1,250 a year. Its opportunity cost is not the coffee; it is whatever else that $1,250 would have done - a car repair covered without borrowing, or 2 months of a utility bill. Naming the alternative is what turns a habit into a decision.
edits.new: A $5 coffee on 250 working days is $1,250 a year. Its opportunity cost is not the coffee; it is whatever else that $1,250 would have done - a car repair covered without borrowing, or several months of utility bills. Naming the alternative is what turns a habit into a decision.

claim: Opportunity cost = next-best alternative; $5 coffee x 250 days = $1,250 a year.
note: Definition matches glossary; $1,250 correct. "2 months of a utility bill" implied an implausible $625 monthly bill; softened. Page last modified Jan. 23, 2025.

claim: 2026 standard deduction $16,100 single / $32,200 MFJ, up from $15,750 / $31,500 for 2025.
note: IR-2025-103, Oct 9, 2025: all four figures match; date and precision correct.

claim: $3,000 at 24% APR accrues ~$2/day, ~$60/month; $150 payment cuts ~$90.

edits.old: On an illustrative 60-month car loan, roughly 40 percent of the first payment may be interest and less than 2 percent of the last. Stretching the same loan to 84 months lowers the monthly payment but raises the total interest paid, because a larger balance is outstanding for longer.
edits.new: On an illustrative 60-month car loan at a 10 percent APR, roughly 40 percent of the first payment is interest and less than 1 percent of the last. Stretching the same loan to 84 months lowers the monthly payment but raises the total interest paid, because a larger balance is outstanding for longer.

note: Page: personal line of credit is unsecured, HELOC secured by a mortgage on the home. Metadata only: last modified Sept. 1, 2026.

edits.old: A $1,000 statement balance paid in full by the due date, 25 days after the cycle closes, costs $0 in interest. The same balance with only a $35 minimum paid starts accruing interest on the remaining $965 from the day the grace period lapses, and the minimum shrinks the debt very slowly.
edits.new: A $1,000 statement balance paid in full by the due date, 25 days after the cycle closes, costs $0 in interest. Paying only a $35 minimum leaves $965 on which interest is charged, and purchases in the next cycle accrue interest from the day each is made, so the minimum shrinks the debt very slowly.
What is a grace period for a credit card?

claim: Grace period avoids purchase interest if paid in full; not required but common; minimum leaves interest-bearing balance.
note: Interest does not start "from the day the grace period lapses"; CFPB: interest on unpaid portion, and new-cycle purchases accrue from purchase date. Re-cited to CFPB en-47 (last reviewed SEP 23, 2024).

claim: Subsidized Direct Loans: need-based undergrad, Dept pays interest in school and grace; unsubsidized accrues from start.
note: Matches CFPB; undergrad sub/unsub rates are the same. Metadata only: last reviewed SEP 12, 2023.

edits.old: A depositor with $200,000 in a single account and $200,000 in a joint account at 1 bank is fully covered - 2 categories, 2 limits. The same $400,000 in 2 single-name accounts at the same bank is insured only to $250,000. Since the FDIC was founded in 1933, no depositor has lost a penny of insured funds.
edits.new: A depositor with $200,000 in a single account and $200,000 in a joint account at 1 bank is fully covered - 2 categories, 2 limits. The same $400,000 split between 2 single accounts in that depositor's name at the same bank is insured only to $250,000.

Two neighbors laid off the same week by employers in 2 different states can face 2 different sets of rules and receive different benefits, because 2 rulebooks apply.
